Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 3 tests with 1 win, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_screen; adoption, new_flow; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Carousel Pet Selector Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a full carousel layout featuring pet animation previews to help users select their favorite companion faster.
candidates.why: Adoption is the largest drop-off in the funnel (60.9% conversion), and visual carousel previews help users connect with pets quickly.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick_friend with carousel layout while preserving the pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off (60.9%), but adoption redesigns have thin historical evidence (+0.6%) and high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Split Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a split layout with a prominent pet naming input box.
candidates.why: Making the certificate screen more interactive and clear strengthens emotional commitment during the adoption step.

guard.reason: The adoption certificate redesign omits the official stamp required by rule 2.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Screen Immediately After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in screen to occur right after picking a pet companion, securing the choice early before heavy processing steps.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in has proven effective (+1.6% average lift), and securing pet choice early helps prevent support issues regarding missing/reset pets.

guard.reason: Reordering the sign-in step inside onboarding is explicitly permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering is well-supported by past test history (+1.6% average lift) and is low-cost to configure.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Pet Crafting Waiting Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout showcasing an animated pet crafting process.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high latency (mean 2336s). A visually rich stage layout reassures users that custom creation is actively taking place.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen with a stage layout while continuing to show the pet crafting process.

candidates.score_note: Targets high latency step (mean 2336s) with a complex visual redesign, though evidence from support emails is absent.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Clarification
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen letting returning users know that signing in will automatically restore their existing pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in will sync and restore any existing pets linked to your account.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful sign-in sync hint without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses the top support theme (8 emails about reset pets) with simple text clarification at low cost.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Quality Sample Hint
candidates.change: Add a photo sample preview component and guidance hint on the photo upload screen demonstrating optimal lighting and angles.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or producing bad results, contributing to adoption step drop-off.

upload_photos.hint: For best generation results, upload bright, front-facing pet photos.

guard.reason: Adds sample photo preview and helpful guidance to the upload screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (adoption) backed by 3 support emails on pet generation issues; easy hint addition.

candidates.title: Path Selection Clarity Headline
candidates.change: Update the choose_path screen headline and hint to clearly distinguish between picking a preset pet companion and creating a custom pet.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean drop-off time (514s), indicating hesitation and lack of clarity on path differences.

choose_path.headline: Select How You Want to Create Your Companion
choose_path.hint: Choose a ready-to-play pet or build a custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Updates headline and hint while continuing to offer both preset pet adoption and custom pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Low cost headline change targeting hesitation at choose_path (514s mean time).

candidates.title: System Tray Pet Control Guide
candidates.change: Add detailed instructions to the home intro screen explaining how to summon, hide, or manage the pet using the desktop system tray icon.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.body: Your pet now lives on your desktop! Use the system tray icon to summon, hide, or access pet settings at any time.
home_intro.hint: Right-click the tray icon anytime to manage desktop display settings.

guard.reason: Adds desktop system tray guidance to home_intro without modifying anything outside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy change addressing 3 support complaints regarding pet control after onboarding finish.

candidates.title: Desktop Notification When Pet is Ready
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts during the waiting step so users feel comfortable minimizing the app.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336s. Allowing users to safely minimize the window prevents abandonment during pet processing.

waiting.body: Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Enables desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen, which is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong fit for long waiting times (2336s mean latency), allowing users to minimize app safely.

candidates.title: Split Story Desktop Mascot Intro Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the onboarding story intro into a split screen layout featuring a mascot graphic showing the pet resting on a work desktop.
candidates.why: Improving the initial hook sets clear expectations for how desktop pets integrate with daily computer use.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring your desktop to life with an interactive virtual pet that works alongside you.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen while continuing to introduce the desktop pet.

candidates.score_note: High cost layout redesign for choose_path step, which has thin past test evidence (+1.0% with no clear effect).
